quotations.english: one is honest and diligent in giving alms

quotations.old_english: Sum man Tobias geháten, swíðe ælmesgeorn
quotations.english: a man, whose name was Tobias, very diligent in giving alms

source_text: ælmes-georn; adj. Diligent in giving alms, benevolent; beneficus, liberalis :-- Sum biþ ár-fæst and ælmesgeorn one is honest and diligent in giving alms, Exon. 79a; Th. 297, 13; Crä. 67. Sum man Tobias geháten, swíðe ælmesgeorn a man, whose name was Tobias, very diligent in giving alms, Ælfc. T. 21, 24.
